$comment: The source of sf-profile-picker's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/profile-picker (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

profiles.x-summary: The profiles the host offers; the picker never changes its own list

rights.x-summary: What this person may do: {create: {personal, shared}, reset}

open.x-summary: Opens the panel; refused (disabled) when disabled, applied when already open

close.x-summary: Closes the panel and gives the focus back to the trigger; refused (closed) when closed

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

skeleton.$comment: The folded trigger with a bar for the profile's name: the first paint before the host sets profiles (§5.4).

accessibility.$comment: The trigger is a button (aria-haspopup menu, aria-expanded); the open panel is a menu named by the label, its rows menuitemradio with aria-checked. F2 and Delete on a row the person may change open its rename and its delete confirmation (keyboard.row); they are actions of the picker, not effects of the menu role.

x-summary: One way to choose, make, rename, remove and reset a profile: a field-like button naming the profile in use, and a panel where every act happens inline. The profiles and the rights are the host's; the component says what was asked.
x-renamed: events.sf-profile-select → select (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events.sf-profile-create → create (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events.sf-profile-rename → rename (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events.sf-profile-delete → delete (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events.sf-profile-reset → reset (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
events: the detail adds the vocabulary's fields (select and delete ids, rename title, create kind) beside the old ones; the old names get the same larger detail (detail-adds)
settings.profiles, rights: the list and the object the host set as properties, declared

forbidden_client_responsibilities: saving the width on a server

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-profile-picker wherever a person chooses between profiles or views of something and may make, rename or remove them: the admin menu's profiles, a record's views.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not let the component change its own list; answer its events by setting profiles and current
Do not build a second profile switcher

x-decisions: version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: the five events take the tag in their DOM names behind dated aliases, profiles and rights are declared, open, close and toggle answer outcomes; a minor while the aliases hold (§4.10).

events: sf-profile-<verb> becomes sf-profile-picker-<verb> (vocabulary §7: the component's tag). The details keep {id}, {label, shared, from}, {id, label} and add the vocabulary's shapes: select {ids}, delete {ids}, rename {title}, create {kind: personal | shared}; the old names get the same detail (detail-adds). The picker asks; the host answers by setting profiles, current or message.

key-effects: the menu role gives Arrow, Home, End, Enter, Space and Escape; Delete and F2 on a row the person may change are mapped in keyboard.row to the picker's own acts delete and rename (§4.6), which no ARIA effect names.

skeleton: the profiles are the host's data and arrive after the first paint, so skeleton.html draws the folded trigger with a bar of the text size for the name (§3, §5.4); presentation.skeleton names it.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus the rights and the reset; probe.json drives choosing, creating, renaming, deleting, resetting and the old names.
css-variables: five public variables read by its own sheet with the role token as fallback (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).
